description: JavaScript code implementing a quiz interface with question navigation, answer selection, and score calculation.

methods.name: createQuestionElement
methods.description: Creates a DOM element containing a question and its answer choices.

methods.name: createRadios
methods.description: Creates a list of radio button inputs for answer choices.

methods.name: choose
methods.description: Records the user's selected answer for the current question.

methods.name: displayNext
methods.description: Displays the next question or the score summary if quiz is complete.

methods.name: displayScore
methods.description: Calculates and displays the user's quiz score.
